title: Victims of stabbing, police shooting identified
article: A woman whose body was found after her husband confronted police with a knife last week was stabbed to death, police said Monday.
Sabah Yousif Rizig, 33, died of multiple stab wounds on Thursday night.
Police went to the fifth floor of a southwest apartment Thursday night after a man called 911 and said he had just killed his wife.

Police said when officers arrived, a man covered in blood and wielding a knife confronted them. The officers unsuccessfully tried to shoot the man with a Taser stun gun after he ignored requests to drop his knife, police said.
An officer with two years on the force then fired three times, killing Walid Mohamed Maragan, 35, of Calgary. Maragan, who died on the scene, was identified by police on Monday.
There are reports that Rizig had recently left her husband and was trying to start a new life.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is investigating the police shooting.
